n: Four new dimensions past the multiverse: Fractal, Mirror, Dream and Origin, each with its own twist. Find them after Infinite in Worlds

Every dimension now has its own sky, not just a new colour: a crystal lattice, a rising sun, a solar system, star-forming pillars, a black hole that swallows stars, a galaxy inside a clock, a day and night with a real sun and moon, bubble universes, a fractal, a mirror lake, a dream sky and the first light
Your engine turns into each new world too, with its own picture
